+

{selected.type==='blue'?'Blue blobs gain +40 energy per fruit, lose energy by moving, flee red blobs, shelter near trees, and spend energy to copy themselves.':'Red blobs gain energy from gentle contact with blue blobs, then must pause — so they cannot boop again instantly.'}

More fruit → blue energy rises → blues copy → more targets for reds → reds copy → blue energy is drained by boops → blues fall → reds run low and fade → fruit recovers → the cycle turns again. Reproduction costs the parent stored energy, and populations level out when fruit or blue prey run short.
